title: FOLLOW THROUGH
pose: Continue the same LEFTWARD throw: card arm arcs down across the body to low screen LEFT just above the knee, EMPTY gloved fingers curl inward after snap. Shoulder follows down, chest settles forward, knees bent again. This is a forceful follow-through, clearly lower than release. Cape still trails screen RIGHT. Keep face visible and gaze locked LEFT.
